messages.content: RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership with local delivery companies announced.
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.
Auto sector revenue index: 79 (baseline: 100). Foot traffic and sales are somewhat down.
People around you are stressed: Patricia Hawkins, Rick Tanner, Angela Wright. The mood is tense.
